Name: Addition
Description: Add two numbers together. The target number gains the value of the source number and the source number is consumed.

Name: Subtraction
Description: Subtract the source number from the target. The source number is consumed.

Name: Multiplication
Description: Multiply the target number by the source. The source number is consumed.

Name: Division
Description: Divide the target number by the source. The source number is consumed. Cannot divide by zero.

Name: Absolute Value
Description: Take the absolute value of a number. Negative becomes positive.

Name: Inverse
Description: Replace a number with its reciprocal (1/x). Cannot invert zero.

Name: Negative
Description: Flip the sign of a number. Positive becomes negative and vice versa.

Name: Positive
Description: Does nothing. A philosophical statement about the nature of positivity.

Name: Square Root
Description: Take the square root of a number. Cannot be used on negative numbers.

Name: Factorial
Description: Roll a die and place d! (factorial of the dice value) into your set.

Name: Square
Description: Square a number (multiply it by itself).

Name: Cosine
Description: Multiply a number by the cosine of a dice roll (in radians).

Name: Base-10 Logarithm
Description: Replace a number with its base-10 logarithm. Must be positive.

Name: Exponential
Description: Replace a number with e raised to its power.

Name: Natural Logarithm
Description: Replace a number with its natural logarithm. Must be positive.

Name: Sine
Description: Multiply a number by the sine of a dice roll (in radians).

Name: Tangent
Description: Multiply a number by the tangent of a dice roll (in radians).

Name: Logarithm
Description: Replace a number with its logarithm in base d (dice roll). Must be positive.

Name: Base-Root
Description: Take the d-th root of a number (dice determines the root). Must be positive.

Name: Power
Description: Raise a number to the power of a dice roll.

Name: Summation
Description: Sum ALL numbers in a player's set into one slot. The rest become empty.

Name: Product
Description: Multiply ALL numbers in a player's set into one slot. The rest become empty.

Name: Second Order Polynomial
Description: Compute a*d^2 + b*d + c where d is a dice roll. Consumes b and c.

Name: First Order Polynomial
Description: Compute a*d + b where d is a dice roll. Consumes b.

Name: Identity Element
Description: Add 0 or multiply by 1. A reminder that some operations change nothing.

Name: Closure Element
Description: Make one number immune from all cards for one turn. Protection!

Name: Distributive Element
Description: Select a number from any player and duplicate it into every other player's set.

Name: Commutative Element
Description: Swap any two numbers on the table between any players.

Name: Pascal's Triangle
Description: Choose a number and collapse its contiguous group (island) into their sum. Adjacent non-empty numbers merge.

Name: Pythagorean Theorem
Description: Compute the hypotenuse of two numbers. The source is consumed.

Name: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
Description: Decompose an integer into its prime factors. Each factor fills a slot.

Name: Euler's Number
Description: Place Euler's number (e ~= 2.718) into your set.

Name: Negative One
Description: Place -1 into your set. Small but mighty.

Name: Sheldon's Number
Description: The best number! If 73 is already in your set you get 73; otherwise you get 12.

Name: Googol
Description: Place 10 into your set OR steal a power-of-10 number from another player.

Name: The Answer
Description: The answer to life the universe and everything. Place 42 into your set.

Name: Phi
Description: Place the golden ratio (phi ~= 1.618) into your set.

Name: Zero
Description: Place 0 into your set. It's nothing but it's honest work.

Name: Pi
Description: Place pi (~= 3.14159) into your set.

Name: Lucky Number
Description: Place 7 into your set. Roll two dice: if they sum to 7 you get another 7!

Name: 2nd Perfect Number
Description: Place 28 into your set. The second perfect number (1+2+4+7+14=28).

Name: 1st Perfect Number
Description: Place 6 into your set. The first perfect number (1+2+3=6).

Name: Fibonacci Number
Description: Starts at 1 and grows to the next Fibonacci number each turn it stays on the table untouched.

Name: Symmetrical Number
Description: Place 69 into your set. It's symmetrical... and divisible by 3.

Name: Tau
Description: Place tau (2*pi ~= 6.283) into your set.

Name: Scientific Notation
Description: Roll a die and place 10^d into your set.

Name: Graham's Number
Description: It's incomprehensibly large. So large we just give you 9 instead.

Name: Cupid's Number
Description: Roll two dice. If both are 3 or less you get 29 (love!). Otherwise you get 14.
